changes.visualSelfReview: Exactly5 blue-violet rounded berries, front2 visibly recessed five-lobed calyx crowns. Initial output right-front six-looking crown was rejected; targeted built-in correction selected. No cluster stem, leaves, labels or real-size inference.

sourceProof.readMethod: Local SHA-verified primary PDF page rendered and re-opened; chestnut/kiwi/blueberry named source examples. Independent image composition, no textbook pixels passed to generator or redistributed.
sourceProof.learningBoundary: Fruit-name and general external appearance examples supporting agr-fruit recognition and later agr-workterms-photo-labels reuse. Source photo count/composition is not copied: app-existing semantics require2 chestnuts,1 kiwi,5 blueberries. No fruit exterior proves evergreen/deciduous class, cultivation climate, variety, ripeness, disease or edibility. Existing actual-tree comparison and qualified lesson text remain separate.

prompts.chestnut: Use case: scientific-educational. Create an original adult Japanese vocational agricultural recognition plate in Royal A+F2.5D style. Subject exactly TWO whole chestnuts, glossy deep chestnut brown natural shells, realistic rounded triangular shapes, gently flattened broad sides, tapered pointed apex with tiny fine hair tuft, each with a broad pale tan rough basal scar clearly visible at the lower side. Stagger them slightly, isolated on warm ivory paper, soft grounded shadows and gentle depth. Clearly HAND-ILLUSTRATED fine ink contour with detailed opaque gouache/colored-pencil painted brush texture, restrained realistic materials and proportions, dimensional 2.5D editorial botanical illustration, not a photograph or photoreal render. Clean close-up square composition, both entire nuts visible with ample margins. No spiny burrs, no cracked shells, no cut flesh, no leaves, no hands, no plate, no additional fruit. NO text, labels, numbers, frame, badges, logos, watermark or gold recoloring. Teach general outer appearance only, do not imply edibility or species diagnostic certainty. Match an elegant painted textbook illustration with obvious fine brush strokes, not a flat vector icon.
prompts.kiwi: Use case: scientific-educational. Original adult Japanese vocational agriculture recognition plate in Royal A+F2.5D. Exactly ONE whole uncut kiwifruit: realistic oval elongated egg shape, brown skin covered with clearly visible fine short soft hairs on surface and silhouetted edge, a small round recessed dry blossom scar at one end. Lay diagonally at three-quarter angle so the full oval shape, hairy texture and small end scar are visible. No cut fruit and no interior flesh. Warm ivory paper background, soft grounded shadow and gentle dimensional depth. Clearly hand-painted botanical editorial illustration, fine dark ink contour, opaque gouache and colored-pencil brush textures with realistic proportions, restrained natural brown and tan tones. Visibly illustrated, not a photograph or photoreal render; detailed 2.5D, not a flat vector icon or toy. Square close-up composition with one complete fruit and ample margins. NO text, labels, numbers, frame, logo or watermark. No leaves, vines, flowers, hands, plates, extra fruit or gold recoloring. General external recognition example only, no variety, flesh-color, ripeness or safety claim.
prompts.blueberry: Use case: scientific-educational. Original adult Japanese vocational agriculture recognition plate, Royal A+F2.5D. Exactly FIVE individual whole blueberries arranged loosely as three behind and TWO in front, all five clearly countable, not attached to stems or grape clusters. Rounded realistically proportioned blue to blue-violet berries with subtle pale dusty wax bloom and tiny natural surface variation. BOTH FRONT TWO berries face the viewer with clearly visible star-shaped recessed blossom-end calyx crowns (five small pointed lobes around a depressed central scar), natural botanical detail, not stars drawn on fruit. The other three berries point differently showing curved skin. Warm ivory paper backdrop and soft grounded shadows. Clearly HAND-ILLUSTRATED fine ink outlines, gouache and colored-pencil painted texture, gentle dimensional 2.5D depth, adult editorial botanical drawing, not a photograph or photoreal 3D render, not flat vector. Square close-up composition with ample outer margins. NO text, labels, numbers, frame, plate, hands, leaves, branches, flowers or extra berries, no watermarks or logos. Natural blueberry colors, no gold recoloring. External appearance recognition only, not an indication of real size, ripeness, quality or food safety.
